name: colony
description: Side pane showing agents as pixel creatures

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Freeze the pane to static frames and stop the animation timer

retentionSeconds.title: Retention seconds
retentionSeconds.description: Seconds a completed agent stays in the pane before it is removed

sessionsDirectory.title: Other sessions folder
sessionsDirectory.description: Absolute path of the folder holding your Claude Code session files (for example /Users/you/.claude/sessions). Set it to also see your other running sessions as figures. Leave empty to never read other sessions.
